name: admin-capability-lockdown
description: Organization control mod: withholds the http and process nouns from $ so no plugin beneath it can reach the network or spawn processes, refuses user-tier plugins by name allowlist or by the $ calls their source declares, and withholds the Bash tool (shellPolicy "deny", default) or, in "guardrail" mode, denies well-known network clients as a bypassable speed bump. Hooks engine.create, plugin.register and tool.call; seat it in the managed prepend tier.
author: claude-code-templates

allowedPlugins.title: Allowed plugins
allowedPlugins.description: Comma-separated plugin names that may register; empty allows any name

refuseCalls.title: Refused $ calls
refuseCalls.description: Comma-separated $ calls (or noun prefixes ending in a dot) a user plugin may not make; default: http. and process.

shellPolicy.title: Shell policy
shellPolicy.description: deny withholds the Bash tool; guardrail denies known network clients (bypassable); allow leaves Bash alone

exaApiKey.title: Exa API key
exaApiKey.description: Your Exa API key; with none set, the built-in WebSearch runs

numResults.title: Results per query
numResults.description: How many Exa results to return

name: universal-audit-log
description: One hook on * that records every event on $ (tool calls, prompts, turns, other plugins' fs/http/process calls) as JSON lines with origin plugin and tier, duration and outcome, including denials. Buffered and flushed to a JSONL file through $.fs at the end of every turn.
author: claude-code-templates

path.title: Log file
path.description: JSONL file the audit lines are written to, relative to the working directory

skipEvents.title: Skipped events
skipEvents.description: Comma-separated events not to record (default: render and log chatter)

flushEvery.title: Flush every
flushEvery.description: Write the buffered lines after this many events

maxBytes.title: Max file size
maxBytes.description: Keep the file under this many bytes, dropping the oldest lines

name: aitmpl
description: /aitmpl opens a component browser above the prompt: the aitmpl.com catalog (agents, commands, MCPs, settings, hooks, skills, loops, mods) read live from the site's public JSON through $.http.fetch. Pick a type or a trending component, filter, page, open a component and install it from there ($.process.run with the fixed CLI argv and a validated path, no shell), drop its install command into the prompt, or open its page in your browser. Hooks session.start, command.run and ui.render on AbovePrompt; browsing costs no tokens.
author: claude-code-templates

siteUrl.title: Site URL
siteUrl.description: The site whose public catalog JSON is browsed (counts.json, components/{type}.json)

pageSize.title: Rows per page
pageSize.description: Components listed per page, capped by the rows the band has

name: jev-model-router
description: Picks the model and the reasoning effort for each task with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached either through TypeSafe's own API or the Vercel AI Gateway. Routes subagent models at agent.spawn and the main loop's effort and model at turn.step, in both directions, falling back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.
author: claude-code-templates

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; preferred over the Gateway, since only it reports a calibrated confidence

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway; with none set the engine's built-in classifier is used instead

provider.title: Backend
provider.description: Which backend to use; "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then the Gateway, then the built-in classifier

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model
typesafeModel.description: Decision model on TypeSafe's own API; empty uses jev-latest

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway; empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai

gatewayModel.title: AI Gateway model
gatewayModel.description: Decision model on the AI Gateway; empty uses typesafe-ai/jev

fastModel.title: Fast tier
fastModel.description: Model alias or id for mechanical, local tasks

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier
balancedModel.description: Model alias or id for ordinary engineering work

deepModel.title: Deep tier
deepModel.description: Model alias or id for hard or high-stakes work

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend more
minUpgradeConfidence.description: How sure the decision must be to raise the model or the effort; being wrong here costs money, so the bar is low

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend less
minDowngradeConfidence.description: How sure it must be to lower the model or the effort; being wrong here means a task gets too little, so the bar is high

routeSubagentModel.title: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Pick the model of each subagent at agent.spawn (the Agent tool takes no effort)

routeMainEffort.title: Route the main loop's effort
routeMainEffort.description: Raise or lower the reasoning effort of the main conversation

routeMainModel.title: Route the main loop's model
routeMainModel.description: Change the model of the main conversation; off by default because switching models mid-session invalidates the prompt cache

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a decision before letting the request through unchanged

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each routing decision to the session log

name: jev-skill-suggestion
description: Keeps the skill listing out of the context window and lets TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model, suggest at most one skill per prompt from the skills' descriptions, the way TypeSafe's skill-suggestion cookbook does: one request ranks every skill and asks whether the prompt needs a skill at all, a second re-reads the top three with their SKILL.md and can reject all of them. The winner is attached to the prompt for the Skill tool; every other skill stays loaded but unlisted. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier when no key is set.
author: claude-code-templates

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; preferred over the Gateway, since only it reports a calibrated confidence

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway; with none set the engine's built-in classifier is used instead

provider.title: Backend
provider.description: Which backend to use; "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then the Gateway, then the built-in classifier

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway; empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai

gatewayModel.title: AI Gateway model
gatewayModel.description: Decision model on the AI Gateway; empty uses typesafe-ai/jev

hideListing.title: Hide the skill listing
hideListing.description: Leave the engine's skill listing out of the main conversation's context; off keeps the listing and only adds the suggestion

rerank.title: Re-read the shortlist
rerank.description: Send a second request that re-reads the top skills with their full description and SKILL.md opening, and can reject them all; off suggests the top of the ranking alone

shortlist.title: Shortlist size
shortlist.description: How many of the ranking the second request re-reads

gateThreshold.title: Needs-a-skill threshold
gateThreshold.description: Mean of the three request nouls (acts on the user's system, would follow a documented procedure, prose does not suffice) under which nothing is suggested

fitsThreshold.title: Fits threshold
fitsThreshold.description: A shortlist whose best per-skill "does this fit" noul is under this is dropped entirely

excerptChars.title: SKILL.md excerpt
excerptChars.description: How many characters of each shortlisted skill's body the second request reads

alwaysListed.title: Always listed
alwaysListed.description: Comma-separated skill names that stay in the listing whatever the prompt (the model can still see and call them)

neverSuggested.title: Never suggested
neverSuggested.description: Comma-separated skill names the decision model is never offered; they stay reachable by typing /name

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a decision before letting the prompt through without a suggestion

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each selection to the session log

name: npm-to-pnpm-rewriter
description: Rewrites npm and npx invocations to pnpm (or yarn / bun) before the Bash tool runs them and tells the model what ran through context. A tool.call hook that forwards a modified event (the modifying placement).
author: claude-code-templates

manager.title: Package manager
manager.description: The package manager npm and npx calls are rewritten to

name: webfetch-cache
description: Short-circuits repeated WebFetch calls for the same URL and prompt within a session, answering { result } from cache without a network round trip. A tool.call hook with TTL and size limits.
author: claude-code-templates

ttlSeconds.title: TTL (seconds)
ttlSeconds.description: How long a cached WebFetch result stays fresh

maxEntries.title: Max entries
maxEntries.description: How many URL + prompt pairs to keep

name: block-destructive-commands
description: Denies Bash commands that match destructive patterns (recursive rm on roots, force push, hard reset, destructive SQL, disk formatting) before they run. A tool.call hook with a Bash matcher that returns { deny } without calling next.
author: claude-code-templates

patterns.title: Extra patterns
patterns.description: Comma-separated regex sources to deny on top of the built-in rules, e.g. \bkubectl\s+delete\b

name: large-edit-confirmation
description: Asks the user, in the engine's AskUserQuestion dialog ($.ui.ask), before Claude edits or overwrites a file larger than a configurable line count; denies by default when nobody can answer (headless runs). A tool.call hook on Edit and Write using $.fs.read.
author: claude-code-templates

maxLines.title: Line threshold
maxLines.description: Files above this many lines need the user's confirmation before an Edit or Write

headless.title: Headless behaviour
headless.description: What to do when nobody can answer (claude -p)

name: protected-paths-guard
description: Denies Edit, Write and NotebookEdit calls on sensitive paths (.env files, lockfiles, CI workflows, git internals, private keys) with a glob allowlist override. A tool.call hook with an array matcher.
author: claude-code-templates

protect.title: Extra protected globs
protect.description: Comma-separated globs to protect on top of the defaults

allow.title: Always-allowed globs
allow.description: Comma-separated globs that are always allowed (checked first)

name: secret-redactor
description: Redacts API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and connection strings from every tool result before the model reads them, notes the redaction through context, and refuses to echo a redacted placeholder back into a Bash command. A tool.call hook in the after placement.
author: claude-code-templates

patterns.title: Extra patterns
patterns.description: Comma-separated regex sources to redact on top of the built-in credential patterns

name: tool-timing-badge
description: Times every tool call and wraps the engine's ToolUse rendering with a colored duration badge from the surface's own element table, on the terminal, Desktop and mobile. Hooks tool.call and ui.render using JSX.
author: claude-code-templates

slowMs.title: Slow threshold (ms)
slowMs.description: Calls at or above this are red, above a quarter of it yellow
